# The steerer, body model A (Book 5 section 02, Book 7 section 07), on the 32 x 48 canvas
# (decision DA-1): approved by the user and adopted into the game (npm run art:adopt).

# assets/art/authoring/people48.py; edit that script, not this map.
# Bloodied layer (Book 7 section 12, Stage 9): drawn over the clothing below half vitality and on
